description:
Navigate from the GCompris main menu to the Sudoku activity and complete the first puzzle level. 

1. From the main menu, find and click on the 'Logical thinking' category (icon showing a puzzle piece or gear/strategy).
2. Locate the 'Sudoku' activity (icon showing a simplified Sudoku grid) and click to open it.
3. You will see a 4x4 grid with some images already placed. Click on the empty cells to select the correct image from the palette.
4. Solve the puzzle: Every row and every column must contain each image exactly once.
5. When completed, a bonus/congratulations animation will appear. 

Complete the puzzle until the bonus animation is shown. Leave GCompris open.
